title: Mercury closing CTA
description: A big centred two-line statement with a periwinkle pill and a quiet pill beside it, then two dark rounded cards side by side, each with a title, a muted sentence and a quiet pill. Stacks on phones.
notes: the cards are optional; without them it's just the statement and buttons
name: mercury-cta

props.name: title
props.description: the centred statement; pass a list of lines to choose the breaks

props.name: cards
props.description: cards under the buttons, usually two (e.g. one per audience)
